name: AtomStack A24 Pro
tagline: Atomstack's 24W unibody-frame diode: set up in minutes, conveyor-ready bed
tldr: AtomStack A24 Pro is a 24W diode engraver and cutter (four 6W diodes) built on a unibody frame you set up in minutes. The 360 × 280 mm bed is small for this power class, but the optional conveyor stretches it to 360 × 800 mm. Diode only: for metal marking, Atomstack sells a separate A24 Pro 1064nm fiber version.
mainObjective: 24W diode engraving and cutting in a quick-setup unibody frame

priceRange.note: Official Atomstack store, Oct 2026: $459 to $1,119 depending on bundle

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack A24 Pro 24W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU: clean engraving and wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame: glasses and exhaust required. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
